product_metadata.title: Deco 79 Metal Sign Live Love Laugh Wall Decor with Scrollwork, 21" x 1" x 28", Brown
features: LIVE LAUGH LOVE metal motivational wall art.
Indoor/outdoor wall decor made from solid iron.
Metallic copper and black shiny metal finish over the scrollwork and acanthus at the top and base and the “LIVE LAUGH LOVE” metal sign in the center.
This metal wall decor measures 21”L x 1”W x 28”H and weighs 2.35 lbs.
Metal accent decor is easy to hang by sawtooth hardware in back and is indoor and outdoor decor safe.
